abstract: As we know that at the heart of Internet of Things (IoT) and Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN), is a communication between multiple sensor modules with a central node. These systems are employed in a various project like smart home automation, smart grid, smart lighting, etc. Connected multiple sensors requires long battery life with low power consumption and transfer of data should be real time. Bluetooth Low Energy(BLE) uses only three advertising channels which will reduce connection time (approx. <6mS) for devices to interconnect with each other, this will lead to lower power consumption. Main drawback of using BLE technology is lower throughput for multiple connections. We have gone thoroughly with different research papers and analyzed that throughput of a link depends on different parameters like number of devices connected to master node, scheduling of process at a master node and environment under which link is present. In this paper, we proposed a scheme by which we have increased throughput of multi-link scenario by scheduling process at a master node. We have used Round Robin (RR) scheduling algorithm to achieve the desired throughput. This algorithm has helped in achieving minimum throughput requirement on each BLE link.

articleTitle: Challenges of Planning with Large Share of Heavy Industry Load in a Remote Distribution Network and Tentative Solutions
abstract: Bangladesh is an emerging economy with rising level of industrialization. Most of the industries consume electricity as their major energy source. Steel industry is one of the major energy-intensive industries of Bangladesh. With the projected growth of economy, the steel industry itself is expected to grow by more than 15% which may impose burden on the current power system. Therefore, proper planning is required to meet the future electricity demand as to adequately supply the loads. Planning with a large steel industry imposes certain challenges which are identified in this paper. Tentative solutions to combat the challenges are also discussed. Simulations are done in some stages to visualize the solutions to the problems.

articleTitle: A Critical Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Based Congestion Control Mechanisms in WSN
abstract: Congestion control in wireless sensor network (WSN) imposes significant challenges. Performance along with sustainability is crucial in a hostile and critical environment. The deployment of huge tiny sensor having constrained resources demands energy optimization and free channel. Traditional congestion control mechanisms are not sufficient to perform efficiently. Artificial Intelligence -based techniques are more prominent in recent years. However, these techniques are also parameter specific and do not come up with a general framework. In the current study various Artificial Intelligence-based congestion control techniques are analyzed and possible research gaps are identified. A critical analysis of state-of-the art techniques are considered which demands a shift from specific to general WSN congestion control framework.

articleTitle: Independent Modal Space Control based Trajectory Control for an Articulated Planar Manipulator with Flexible Links
abstract: In this paper, trajectory control of a planar articulated flexible manipulator having two links is achieved using the technique of independent modal space control. For this, the joint torques of the manipulator are expressed as functions of joint errors and joint error derivatives. The governing equations belong to the class of second-order differential equations whose coefficients vary with time. Application of independent modal space control theory on these equations yield a method for finding the control gains for a proportional-derivative controller. The controller thus developed is described as coupled-error dynamics controller. Simulation results show that the proposed controller gives output close to that of a computed-torque controller.

articleTitle: AdaRes: ResNet50 with AdaSwarm for Glaucoma Classification & Detection
abstract: Glaucoma is an illness that damages the human optic nerve and causes permanent blindness over the age of 60. It is an irreversible disease that results in loss of vision. To detect glaucoma from color retinal images, we use a variety of deep learning techniques. In this paper, for detection of glaucoma, an architecture has been proposed that is based on deep learning with meta-heuristic algorithm (Adaswarm). Firstly, the input images are pre-processed image. Since, these images are imbalanced so to balance this SMOTE technique is used and finally the proposed method is used to detect the glaucoma. To evaluate the proposed method several classification parameters are used.

articleTitle: An Automated System for Identification of Tweets Requiring Customer Service Concern
abstract: Social Network Communication has become an important factor for businesses for their successful operation. It has become important to connect with customers and offer support to them on these platforms. Several customers prefer to post comments, suggestions or complaints about a company’s products and services to online media such as Facebook, Twitter etc. because it is convenient for them and it increases pressure on product owners/service providers to respond. Twitter is a prominent social media platform with 206 million daily active users. Research from Twitter and Sprinklr suggest that 2 out of 3 people prefer Twitter for customer service over other social media platforms. It pays off for businesses when they attend to customer concerns or social media since studies show that people who receive customer service on Twitter from telecom brands preferred those brands 3 times more than those that had not received support. Yet many businesses aren’t connecting with consumers on Twitter. In this paper two unsupervised classification models are proposed that performs clustering on customer support dataset on twitter in such a way that companies can segregate those messages/tweets in which customers are needing genuine help. This will help the companies to actively respond to these customers and this can help increase their customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Image Identification for Crime Detection using Convolutional neural networks
abstract: Fingerprint photographs taken at the site of a crime are critical clues in solving serial crimes. We demonstrate a comprehensive fingerprint recognition system for crime scenes using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). Images are retrieved from the crime scene and preserved in the database utilising methods ranging from simple physical processing techniques to advanced physiochemical processing techniques. Pre-processing the fingerprint pictures requires the use of appropriate enhancing techniques. The characteristics of prepossessed information are used as input to train the classifier the CNN. After training, it compares and determines whether a picture is a crime or not depending on its accuracy. Our suggested technique was tested using SOCOFing, FVC2004 DB1, and images gathered and saved as dataset names. It will get recognition rate of 97 percent our proposed models.

articleTitle: MEHE based Prediction of Health Condition using LBM in Edge Computing Systems
abstract: Low range of Lean Body Mass (LBM) is troublesome for a variety of reasons, including potential implications on health, ability to carry out everyday activities, and emotional and psychological states. Loss of LBM leads to a variety of health problems, including exhaustion, an increased risk of injury, and a slower metabolic rate. LBM [%] value is calculated and is checked against the normal range of "75-85" and the result is analysed with three categories (Unhealthy: Level 1, Healthy and Unhealthy: Level 2). In today's web-based society, the Internet of Things (IoT) and Edge computing are two emerging topics. The current research on the integration of IoT/Web of Things (WoT) devices with Edge Computing is dominated by the Smart Health Care system. Modified Enhanced Homomorphic Scheme encryption system is used to safeguard the processing of patient data and test findings. The LBM [%] value is determined and evaluated using the MEHE scheme algorithm.

articleTitle: On The Design Of Non-linear Disturbance Observer For Formation Acquisition Of Multiple Wheeled Mobile Robots
abstract: This paper focuses on the formation acquisition of multiple wheeled mobile robots (WMR) with external disturbance. WMR’s are modeled using Euler-Lagrange like equations of motion. Backstepping technique is employed to derive control strategy. Lyapunov analysis shows WMRs acquire desired formation asymptotically. Non linear disturbance observer (NDOB) is proposed to reduce the effect of disturbance. Finally, simulations are carried out to show efficacy of proposed NDOB.

articleTitle: Automated Lung Segmentation On Chest CT Using Deep Learning
abstract: A pandemic of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) devastated humanity before the end of 2019, which was triggered by severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS), which originated in Wuhan, China. This sickness has claimed the lives of many people. The pandemic's consequences have been more severe in the world's most populous countries. Despite the fact that over a billion immunizations have been distributed to Indian citizens, the epidemic has not abated as of October 21, 2021. While certain limits are being eased, the threat of the dreaded "fourth wave" remains. In these situations, having technologies for swift disease testing and diagnosis is critical, since it allows for a much speedier process. Using a CT scan of the lungs, this research will provide vision into a model that may proficiently and correctly envisage the existence of COVID-19.

articleTitle: A UAV Mission Planning With Limited Fuel Capacity
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), also referred to as drones, are now being used intensively in many applications including surveillance missions, traffic monitoring, agriculture or disaster and crisis management, since they avoid risking human lives while their manageability permits reaching areas that are hard to access. These vehicles are usually controlled by a number of operators inside one or more Ground Control Stations (GCSs), depending on the size of the mission. This paper presents two new formulations for a single UAV mission planning with limited fuel capacity in a given environment. The first is to obtain the optimal minimum fuel consumption trajectories to accomplish a mission. The second gives the minimum fuel tank capacity to achieve the same mission. A mission starts from a starting point, which is assigned by the ground control station (GCS), from and to which a UAV starts and ends its mission. The mission then continues by visiting a set of tactically located way-points. Due to limited fuel capacity, the UAV has to reconfigure its mission routes among the given set of way-points and an assigned aerial fuel station to successfully achieve the mission. The proposed formulations optimal results are simulated and compared together and also compared with the results of the case where the fuel capacity is not limited to elaborate the difference between these scenarios and clarify the importance of the limited fuel capacity problem and its effect on mission planning.

articleTitle: Transient Analysis of Fog Nodes with Catastrophes
abstract: The networking business has recently seen significant transformations. It also necessitates high-speed operations and the ability to solve difficult problems. The Internet-of-Things (IoT) is being presented as a method to manage these changes from a variety of technical perspectives. Handling such large amounts of network data, as well as its privacy and security, as well as QoS requirements and the variety of underlying networking components, are all issues in IoT implementations. Fog computing is a new technology paradigm that instead of executing in the cloud, delivers a set of networking services closer to the user. In terms of minimising latency, scalability of the networking infrastructure, reliability in networking services, and security in networking devices, fog computing outperforms cloud computing. As a result, fog computing has altered the technical mindset by bringing cloud-based networking services closer to the client level in order to give the highest quality of service. There are numerous scenarios in which fog servers fail. We investigate the model with Markovian queue having heterogeneous VMs and fog server catastrophes in this work. Exact formulas for the transient probabilities of system capacity are obtained for queues with discouraged arrival and infinite VMs.

articleTitle: Effect of the Face Wears on Acoustic Parameters of Speech
abstract: Wearing a mask and maintaining a social distance, washing hands, and using hand sanitizers have all become conventional, and people are gradually adopting them as part of their daily routine. If crimes involving voice are committed while wearing the mask or handkerchief, there is cause for alarm. Because mask quality influences speech samples, this issue has piqued the interest of speech researchers all around the world. Because people were at home or hiding, the number of offences reported to the police station was substantially reduced. Medical industry, Government sectors etc. which fell under the emergency services, there the crimes like bribery, extortion where only voice of a person did a job, unexpectedly appeared. As a result, the number of offences involving voice did not decrease. The temporal and acoustic properties of voice samples obtained from people wearing tight masks (cotton masks), handkerchiefs, good grade N95 masks, and without any face covering are assessed in this paper. The results show the phenomenal spectral effect for the instances where tight cotton mask and handkerchief was used as a face cover as there was an articulatory constriction due to the face wear. In the case of N95 mask there is enough space for normal articulatory functions of the vocal tract, hence no spectral change was observed. In all instances fundamental frequency F0 remained untouched. The harmonics to noise ratio, effect on energy deterioration observed is also reported in this paper.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of MOSFET and FINFET DRAM N*N Array
abstract: Memory is a means of storing information in the form of ones and zeros. Every digital device, today, has a significant amount of memory embedded inside. Memories, it is believed, take up lot of the chip area. DRAM is a specific type of RAM (random access memory) that stands for "dynamic random-access memory". All types of modern desktops, laptops and mobile workstations require some kind of RAM to function, and DRAM is one kind of RAM that is generally seen in those. These are called "volatile" because of the fact that transistors need electricity to work and anything stored will disappear if the PC is turned off. The 4*4 DRAM memory has been designed, implemented and analysed using gpdk090 technology library using the cadence tool.

articleTitle: Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy based Sensor System for Detection of Detergents in Cow Milk
abstract: People, irrespective of age, gender, and geographical location, consume milk in one or another form. Milk is considered as super food and immunity booster due to its ingredients. Adulteration of milk is mostly due to the gap between demand and supply. Water, urea, starch, detergents, formaldehyde, and hydrogen peroxides are commonly used adulterants. Detergent is added to pure milk to reduce microbial growth so that to increase its shelf life. Detergent causes health problems like indigestion, stomach ulcers, and imbalance in the absorption of organic matters in humans. The work presented in this paper focuses on the detection of detergents in cow milk with Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy (EIS). A designed EIS sensor setup, with an Impedance analyzer board and Phase shift to voltage converter circuitry are employed to assess the impedance (components like magnitude, phase, or real and imaginary values) of the milk. The impedance of the electrolyte which is milk changes with the addition of detergent. The ionic nature of the detergent is responsible for changes in capacitance and in turn impedance of the sensor. The Sensor is responsive for variation of detergent 0% to 10% in 100ml of milk. The time for detection is around 35 seconds. As the impedance also depends on the frequency, its effect on the impedance is also observed. The presented work proves the EIS method rapid and low cost for detection of detergent in cow milk.

articleTitle: Wideband Suspended Strip Feed 30°-60°-90° Triangular Microstrip Patch Antenna
abstract: The design of an antenna structure with suspended feed strip and microstrip patch to enhance the impedance bandwidth is presented. The antenna incorporates two patch design one is rectangular and other is triangular patch. The rectangular patch is used as a feed strip and the 30° -60° -90° triangular patch as a radiator. The rectangular patch is fed by a coaxial probe and this couples the energy to the triangular patch. The whole antenna design is suspended above the ground plane to obtain better impedance bandwidth. Using this design approach the antenna achieved an impedance bandwidth of 550MHz at the operating frequency of 2.4GHz.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of company reviews using Machine Learning
abstract: Employees and job seekers today evaluate their experiences through online reviews of the company. These reviews can also be used by companies to understand their employee’s perception. This study aims to extract aspects of importance from the user reviews and the overall sentiment is classified. The suggested method entails pre-processing user reviews with a variety of methodologies, followed by sentiment score based on aspects and feature extraction. In the proposed system, sentiment is classified using Multinomial Nave Bayes (MNB), Decision Trees (DTs), Support Vector Machines (SVM), and Random Forest (RF) classifiers. Practical implementation is done on a glassdoor review dataset containing reviews from current and former employees of Google company is used. Results implicate that Random Forest produces best results as compared to the other algorithms.

articleTitle: Multiple Cavity Modeling Technique Analysis at Faulty KA Band Waveguide Joint
abstract: This paper present multiple cavity modeling technique analysis of crosstalk at faulty waveguide joint in Ka band. The structure is also analyzed using CST microwave studio, a 3D software. Numerical data obtained from multiple cavity modeling technique analysis have been verified and compared with simulated data. The result shows good agreement between theory and simulation.

articleTitle: Multi-port Converter Topology for Simultaneous Power Conversion of Buck/Boost and Inversion operation
abstract: Multiport converters are given more importance for different applications due to the advantages such as high efficiency, high power density and low cost. Each multiport converter topology has different number of power processing stages, different number of switches and different control techniques. This paper proposes a single-stage multiport power converter topology for integrating PV-Battery to the three phase ac load application. Power flow between all the three ports are managed using Finite Control Set Model Predictive technique. The proposed converter has reduced number of switches and conversion stages to connect PV and battery to the three phase ac load system compared to conventional switches. The converter topology is based on bidirectional simultaneous power conversion of dc/dc and dc/ac system. The topology allows the connection of a low voltage battery that acts as a buffer in the standalone system. Simulation results show the efficacy of the multiport bidirectional converter to manage the power flow between PV- Battery connected to three-phase ac load system.

Author Keywords: Finite Control Set Model Predictive Control

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of End to End Inventory Management System for Perishable Goods
abstract: Perishable items are the ones that quickly become spoiled or unsafe for consumption and usage. They are the core of supply chain management due to the limited shelf-life. There are many forms of perishable items viz fresh food products like fruits and vegetables, dairy, poultry, frozen or processed foods, commodities like cosmetics, health care products like medicines, oxygen and lifesaving items like blood. The paper addresses issues of the order management system in the estimation of the demands of the essential perishable items based on its fluctuating demands. The prevalent work was not able to correctly estimate the demands of the items labeled as essential goods. This article describes the identification of the most relevant features to estimate the replenishment policies. The work carried out contemplates the feature importance, exceptionally taking into account the effect of calamities or celebrations and festivities. The novelty of the work lies in comparing the complex two-step models using linear programming and reinforcement learning. The proposed model with simple machine learning algorithms is seen more effective for small scale businesses. The devised model focuses on accurately predicting the order estimate of perishable product under dynamically impacting factors in the supply chain management.

articleTitle: Emulation of Intel’s 8086 Microprocessor using Rust and Web Assembly
abstract: The existing Intel’s 8086 microprocessor emulators are hampered by significant short falling that includes : The existing emulator software does not support operating systems such Linux and mac OS. Students could not use the emulator on devices other than desktops since the emulator required was bundled as an installer file for Windows. The emulator required several disparate windows to read the execution of programs along with values of registers, flags, and memory, thus hampering the overall user experience. The 8086 Emulator with Rust and WASM improves upon these issues by providing a web platform with a simple and adjustable interface compatible across various screen sizes and operating systems and a command-line platform for the accustomed programmers and SSH command line users. In a world where many devices support web browsers, a web version makes it very convenient for the global user base, especially when it performs without sacrificing speed or correctness; allowing students to test and run their programs on any device, at any place, as long as they have a web browser.

articleTitle: Data Recording Power Monitor Socket and Monitoring Software System for Offline and Online Application
abstract: This paper describes the process of creating a power monitor socket capable of accurately measuring the amount of power going through a device and store the collected data regardless of network connection where the device is still capable of function offline and sync up seamlessly when online wherein the user could access it anytime through a mobile application. The data collection and database update will occur every five (5) seconds, providing the user with a detailed breakdown of the power being consumed by the device connected to the prototype while simultaneously providing them with the monetary value equivalent to that consumption. It was done through the integration of hardware and software, primarily composed of various sensors and a Raspberry Pi Zero W, with the latter being programmed to compute for the required values, have its own database, as well as data transmission to a local network, for both offline and online data storage respectively.

articleTitle: Human Fall Detection in Surveillance Videos
abstract: The development of healthy aging and the assistance of older people in their everyday activities is one of the most pressing concerns in modern cultures. Human fall is such an irregular action that occurs when a person gets startled and loses their equilibrium, resulting in sliding. These accidents among old people can result in long-term impairments and even death. Automated detection of falls has gotten a lot of interest in computer vision and pattern recognition areas because of its social and economic implications. Although wearable sensor-based techniques have achieved excellent detection rates, some potential users are hesitant to wear them, and so their usage has not yet become standard. As a result, new ways have arisen, such as vision-based solutions. Fall detection that is accurate for the help of older persons is critical in reducing the number of fatalities and injuries caused by falls. The influence of deep learning on vision-based systems, such as action recognition, has transformed the landscape. The emergence of Smart Environments and Internet of Things concepts, together with the growing number of cameras in our everyday lives, creates an ideal setting for vision-based solutions. As a result, this paper aims to provide a vision-based method that uses Convolutional Neural Networks to determine if a series of frames involves a fall event or not. The proposed approach is using Histogram of Oriented Gradient (HOG) features extracted from series of frame to determine the fall event.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of SSPP based Wideband High Gain End-fire Antenna
abstract: This letter proposes a novel end-fire antenna based on spoof surface plasmon polaritons (SSPPs). Because of the high frequency, the SSPP waveguide excites the antenna's main radiator. The SSPP waveguide's transmission performance, which is realised by etching on the metal a pattern of corrugated grooves at regular intervals strip. Very good impedance match is given when quasi tem is converted to the SSP mode in which the grooves are changed to next level in the microstrip line. In the bottom side of the antenna a metal or we can say a metal sheet which is U in shape is placed so that the front to back ratio can be improved. The end-fire antenna's directors are made of three printed metal strips, which improve the directivity. A simulation of end-fire antenna is done in this paper. Gain of antenna is around 6dBi at 7 giga hertz of frequency .low energy loss,, higher band, higher gain ,easy to construct and smaller size are some of advantages of this antenna.

articleTitle: X-Band Cavity-Backed Stacked Rectangular Microstrip Antenna for Super-Wideband and High Isolation
abstract: A rectangular one bottom four top (1B4T) stacked antenna has been proposed in X-band. The antenna has superwideband, high gain and high isolation. The two cavity walls have been used to improve the bandwidth (BW) and gain performance of the antenna. The antenna has been designed with air substrate for broad BW and high efficiency. The antenna designed at the center frequency of 10.3 GHz is yielding a BW of 72% (6.59-14.01 GHz) for |S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>| ≤ –10 dB and a minimum isolation of 36 dB between two such antennas. The results show that it has a maximum gain of 12.62 dBi, with an average gain of 11 dBi over the entire impedance BW. The radiation efficiency is above 97% throughout the super-wide BW. The achieved features make the proposed antenna a good candidate for FMCW radars and military applications.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization of Headbox Control System for Paper Factory
abstract: Paper mills have exhibited a significant contribution in the development of economy of India for last so many years. The process of a good quality paper making is very complex that is accomplished in many stages. The one very vital stage is in this entire process is the headbox. It has been chosen as the topic of research in this paper. There is always a need to have optimum automatic controllers for almost every stage. In this work two very effective control strategies have been used i.e. PID and LQG for developing the control system in MATLAB. Further, the Genetic Algorithm (GA) has been applied to optimize the PID controller parameters.

articleTitle: Quasi Z-source DC-DC Converter with Supercapacitor for Photovoltaic Application
abstract: This paper illustrates the behavior and analysis of charging and discharging of a supercapacitor connected to a photovoltaic system. Here, a quasi Z-source DC to DC power converter is used as the interfacing power circuit to condition the PV power. The mathematical and SIMULINK models of the supercapacitor, PV, and converter are presented. The SIMULINK model of the MPPT algorithm is also explained. Perturb and Observe technique is used to arrive the maximum power region. The simulation results are presented and examined to evidence that the maximum power is harvested. It also showed that the energy storage is achieved with supercapacitor.

articleTitle: Implementation of Robotic Process Automation (RPA) in Digital Marketing
abstract: Robotic Process Automation (RPA) has flourished since the recent wave of digital transformation. To some RPA may sound intimidating and ominous at first, but in retrospect, it is an extremely practical solution for traditionally time-consuming repetitive tasks. RPA tools aim to automate processes that have always required a human to physically perform the task but do not necessarily require strategic thinking. In this paper we talk about RPA and one of the RPA tools- UiPath, then go on to discuss the prospect and scope of automation in the field of Digital Marketing and how using RPA will largely benefit this section of business by superseding the manually done repetitive tasks of digital marketing. This technology has been a boon to many sectors of business. In the second half of the paper, we describe a use case in digital marketing and how using software bots we can increase efficiency and decrease time and workforce consumed while maintaining the quality of work. We implement our solution using the UiPath tool to build a workflow for the same and deploy the bot.

articleTitle: An Analysis on Energy Management of Domestic Buildings Using ANN Techniques
abstract: As a practice, energy conservation entails minimising the amount of energy used, which can be done through utilising energy more effectively. And because of this increasing demand of energy in day to day life, energy conservation has been an important challenge in today’s life. So a better management of energy usage in buildings is very much essential. As in Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) system, heating load (HL) and cooling load (CL) are counted as a main part of loads in buildings, the accurate estimation of these loads of a building is very much important. It involves the accurate analysis of energy consumption and the different aspects of enhancing the energy efficiency in buildings. As we know that the artificial neural networks (ANN) can perform more efficiently than the linear programs. So, in this paper A feed forward network is being used for performance analysis of HL and CL of a domestic building by considering eight input variables. As a result, the mean absolute error (MAE), mean square error (MSE), and mean relative error (MRE) for HL and CL are respectively 0.1248, 0.1686, and 0.0611 for HL and 0.0087, respectively for CL.

articleTitle: A Review on Optimisation Strategies for Cloud Computing Technologies
abstract: Nowadays Cloud Computing is more and more used in the IT field as it is less complex to use and also economic in nature. Also we need to consider the environmental factor while using it. This paper reviews the methods by which the energy utilised by cloud computing can be reduced and also by reducing the waste carbon using various techniques. And several data centres are created which provides required space, computation, nodes in the network and operates smoothly and efficiently. In order to increase the performance and reduce the cost, the energy consumed by the data centres are to be reduced. In the face of continuous development in data and computing related applications, energy optimization is complex and also much needed. A brief about various works related to energy optimisation in cloud computing is provided in this paper.

articleTitle: LIDAR based Detection of Small Vehicles
abstract: This paper proposes a lidar based vehicle detection system able to detect small vehicles such as cars and vans. With the recent advances in the sector, Autonomous or semi-autonomous vehicles have gained large popularity. The biggest challenge for these vehicles is fast and reliable object or obstacle detection. A 3-D lidar has been the most reliable sensor to provide this information. To extract meaningful information from LiDAR point clouds current systems, deploy various deep learning models. These models are complex and work on large data. In this paper a system is proposed to detect the vehicles from lidar data with point cloud processing and machine learning. Preprocessing is performed with the Open3d library. For detection vehicle dimensions are used. For classification four different classifiers have been used. The system can detect vehicles such as cars and vans.

articleTitle: Pulsed BPSK RF Subsystem for X-band Surveillance Radars
abstract: This paper describes the architecture of multifunctional RF subsystem designed for surveillance Radar, which is a fully coherent pulse Doppler X-Band Radar. RF subsystem which plays a critical role in the performance of the Radar, generates BPSK modulated Barker coded Radar waveforms in X-band. A Simplest architecture using analog mixer is being adapted into the design for BPSK modulation and demodulation resulting in less component count. Phase Locked Loop (PLL) based low phase noise Synthesizer is used as the local oscillator (LO) source for up converting the BPSK signal to X-band. Same LO is being used for down converting X-band signal for achieving coherency. RF Module is designed for lightweight, less complexity, minimum power consumption and low cost. The module is realized and qualified to meet the performance under all weather conditions.

articleTitle: Improved State Feedback Controller Design Using Lyapunov-Krasovskii Functional for Linear Discrete Systems with time-delay
abstract: The work presented in this paper uses Lyapunov-Krasovskii Functional (LKF) to solve discrete-time system stabilization problem with time-varying delay. Invoking summation inequality and the extended reciprocally convex combinational lemma, forward difference of the chosen LKF is done to give a tighter estimate. To ensure asymptotic stability of the system in the sense of Lyapunov, a delay-dependent stability criteria is derived in the form of Linear Matrix Inequality (LMI). Finally, a numerical example is provided to demonstrate the applicability of developed theory.
